objective: Determine how much exact canonical role and exact frontier-relative depth indexing remains necessary inside the common C+D0+D1 signed exchange MSS, without changing family membership or selecting individual coordinates by outcome.

frozenCarrier.pairOrientation: lexicographic endpoint orientation inherited from EW-RS-069

capacityIndexModes.name: C_ROLELESS
capacityIndexModes.definition: Discard canonical role index i from every C:i signed token; retain separate counts of positive and negative changed C coordinates.

capacityIndexModes.name: C_EXACT_ROLE
capacityIndexModes.definition: Retain exact canonical role index i and sign for every changed C:i coordinate.

depthIndexModes.name: D_DEPTHLESS
depthIndexModes.definition: Within each owner channel D0/D1, discard depth d and retain separate counts of positive and negative changed depth coordinates.

depthIndexModes.name: D_DEPTH_PARITY
depthIndexModes.definition: Within each owner channel retain depth parity d mod 2 and sign, with counts per owner/parity/sign bucket.

depthIndexModes.name: D_EXACT_DEPTH
depthIndexModes.definition: Retain exact depth d and sign for every changed D0:d/D1:d coordinate.

structuralProcedure: Start from the frozen RS-072 C+D0+D1 pair signatures for SIGN and SIGNED_PARITY.
For C_ROLELESS, quotient only the C:i index while preserving the number and direction of changed capacity coordinates.
For D_DEPTHLESS or D_DEPTH_PARITY, quotient only exact depth indices while preserving owner separation and signed changed-coordinate counts.
Form each OOO triple key as the sorted multiset of its three transformed pair signatures.
Freeze candidate feature catalogs, dependency rows, and structural bases before scalar replay.

selectionAndMss.partialOrder: C_ROLELESS < C_EXACT_ROLE and D_DEPTHLESS < D_DEPTH_PARITY < D_EXACT_DEPTH
selectionAndMss.output: Report all inclusion/minimal grid points exact on every carrier for each encoding; do not force a total order across incomparable gauges.

measurements: image rank and kernel relative to full C+D0+D1 control
antiCircularity: Both encodings, both capacity-index modes, all three depth-index modes, and the six candidate grid points are frozen before scalar inspection.
No individual role i, depth d, owner exception, or bucket split is selected using W/D/L.
Owner separation D0 versus D1 remains fixed in this experiment.
EW-RS-065 matched dependencies and the RS-069 pair orientation remain unchanged.
falsifiers: C_EXACT_ROLE+D_EXACT_DEPTH must reproduce the RS-072 C+D0+D1 control ranks for each encoding.
Any candidate with structurally zero residue and nonzero scalar residue is insufficient.
No post-hoc role/depth exception is allowed.
nextIfCompressedPasses: Freeze the minimal common role/depth quotient and then test owner-channel merging and small circuit functionals inside that quotient.
nextIfExactIndicesRequired: Retain exact indices and move directly to outcome-independent basis/circuit reduction without coordinate-specific deletion.
interpretationGuards: Role/depth index sufficiency is bounded Q-V evidence on the declared carriers.
Canonical role index is a descriptor-canonical coordinate, not a physical global column index.
No Q-A/Q-F, standard-7x6, universal theorem, or center-opening proof follows.
